args.query:
-- Create cleaned_measurements table with structure matching measurements
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE 
    -- Remove cognitive_score outliers (outside reasonable range)
    cognitive_score >= 50 
    AND cognitive_score <= 88
    -- Remove reaction_ms outliers (exclude values > 720 ms, which is far above the 75th percentile)
    AND reaction_ms <= 720;

-- Verify the cleaned table
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records,
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog,
       MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog,
       AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
       MIN(reaction_ms) as min_reaction,
       MAX(reaction_ms) as max_reaction,
       AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction
FROM cleaned_measurements;

-- Show removed records (original minus cleaned)
SELECT 'Removed records (9 total)' as category, 
       COUNT(*) as count 
FROM measurements 
WHERE 
    cognitive_score < 50 OR cognitive_score > 88
    OR reaction_ms > 720;

-- List removed outlier records
SELECT 
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    participant_id,
    recorded_at,
    CASE 
        WHEN cognitive_score < 50 OR cognitive_score > 88 THEN 'Cognitive outlier'
        WHEN reaction_ms > 720 THEN 'Reaction time outlier'
        ELSE 'Both outliers'
    END as outlier_type
FROM measurements
WHERE 
    cognitive_score < 50 OR cognitive_score > 88
    OR reaction_ms > 720;

-- Let's verify what's in the original table again
SELECT COUNT(*) as total,
       AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
       AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
       -- Calculate IQR for cognitive_score
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as Q1_cog,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as Q3_cog,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as Q1_react,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as Q3_react
FROM measurements;

-- Verify what's in the original table
SELECT COUNT(*) as total,
       AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
       AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react
FROM measurements;

-- Drop the current cleaned table and recreate with better IQR-based threshold
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;

-- Finalize cleaned_measurements table with scientifically appropriate outlier removal
-- I the interquartile range approach
-- Cognitive scores 2,3,4 are clearly outliers (well below Q1 - 1.5*IQR)  
-- Cognitive score 92 is an extreme outlier (> Q3)
-- Reaction times 1450, 1420, 1395 are extreme outliers (far above Q3 + 1.5*IQR)

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE 
    cognitive_score >= 50  
    AND cognitive_score <= 91
    AND reaction_ms <= 600;

-- Verify the new cleaned table statistics
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records,
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog,
       MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog,
       AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
       MIN(reaction_ms) as min_reaction,
       MAX(reaction_ms) as max_reaction,
       AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction
FROM cleaned_measurements;

-- Create a summary of removed outliers for documentation
CREATE TABLE cleaning_summary AS
SELECT 'Removed cognitive outliers (score < 50)' as removal_reason,
       participant_id,
       cognitive_score,
       reaction_ms,
       recorded_at
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score < 50
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Removed cognitive outliers (score > 91)',
       participant_id,
       cognitive_score,
       reaction_ms,
       recorded_at
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score > 91
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Removed reaction time outliers (reaction_ms > 600)',
       participant_id,
       cognitive_score,
       reaction_ms,
       recorded_at
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score >= 50 AND cognitive_score <= 91 AND reaction_ms > 600;

-- Check if any outliers remain in the cleaned table
SELECT COUNT(*) as outlier_count
FROM cleaned_measurements
WHERE cognitive_score < 50 OR cognitive_score > 91 OR reaction_ms > 600;

-- Show detailed breakdown of removed records
SELECT removal_reason, COUNT(*) as count
FROM cleaning_summary
GROUP BY removal_reason
ORDER BY removal_reason;
SELECT removal_reason, COUNT(*) as count FROM cleaning_summary GROUP BY removal_reason ORDER BY removal_reason;

SELECT cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms > 600
ORDER BY reaction_ms DESC;

-- Final comparison: Original vs Cleaned statistics
SELECT 'ORIGINAL TABLE' as dataset,
       COUNT(*) as records,
       ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 2) as avg_cognitive,
       ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 2) as avg_reaction
FROM measurements
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CLEANED TABLE',
       COUNT(*),
       ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 2),
       ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 2)
FROM cleaned_measurements;
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;
